_readme: Ground-truth doc_ids for the PostgreSQL structured study matcher audit.
Each top-level key is a fixture name from matcher_golden_queries.py.
For each fixture the user populates:
- description:                    one-line human summary of the case
- expected_doc_ids_relevant:      studies the matcher SHOULD return in the top ~50
- expected_doc_ids_must_not_return:  studies the matcher MUST NOT return (clear mismatches)
The integration script scripts/test_matcher_live.py reads this file,
runs the matcher against the live Postgres, and reports:
- precision@10 = fraction of top-10 returned that are in expected_doc_ids_relevant
- recall@50    = fraction of expected_doc_ids_relevant that made the top-50
- any must-not-return doc_ids that were actually returned (hard fail)
Leave a list empty ([]) if you don't have ground-truth for that fixture;
the script will still run it and print top-K results for manual eyeballing.
Doc_ids should match exactly what is stored in the Postgres 'studies.doc_id' column.

simple_lung_adeno.description: Stage IV NSCLC with EGFR mutation — baseline lung biomarker flow

hn_scc_multi_axis.description: 80yo M recurrent left oral tongue SCC, CPS 100, post-glossectomy, progressing on pembrolizumab (canonical audit-log case)
hn_scc_multi_axis.notes: Highest priority fixture — we already know the matcher hard-filtered ARTSCAN III and SCC of Unknown Primary as mismatches due to the upstream histology mislabel. Add doc_ids for the correct reference studies (EXTREME, KEYNOTE-040, KEYNOTE-048, RTOG 9610, etc.) and the known-wrong NSCLC studies that should never appear.

triple_negative_breast.description: 55yo F stage III TNBC, neoadjuvant setting
triple_negative_breast.notes: Validates the TNBC special case path and HER2- trastuzumab exclusion.

prostate_crpc.description: 72yo M metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer with BRCA mutation
prostate_crpc.notes: Validates prostate site + PARP-relevant biomarker handling.

colorectal_msi_high.description: 62yo stage IV MSI-high KRAS wild-type metastatic colorectal cancer
colorectal_msi_high.notes: Validates the MSI JSONB Tier-1 path and GI site filter.

breast_her2_neg_liver_mets.description: 58yo F ER+/PR+/HER2- metastatic breast cancer with liver mets
breast_her2_neg_liver_mets.notes: Stress test: the matcher currently hard-filters to %breast% only. Any studies about hepatic metastasis management in breast cancer that live under cancer_location LIKE %liver% will be silently dropped. Populate expected_doc_ids_relevant with a few of those to measure the recall hit.

empty_query.description: Completely empty query — should short-circuit before touching the DB
empty_query.notes: Ground truth is 'empty result'; the script still runs it as a sanity check.

biomarker_only.description: KRAS G12C mutation, no cancer site specified
biomarker_only.notes: No hard site filter applied. The matcher OR-joins all scoring conditions — can return studies from any cancer site that score positive on KRAS G12C.

cps_score_of_100_raw.description: The literal 'CPS score of 100' string from the live /rag audit log — bug record
cps_score_of_100_raw.notes: The parser collapses 'CPS score of 100' to ('CPS SCORE OF 100', None) and searches for JSONB key 'CPS SCORE OF 100', which never exists. This fixture documents the bug; leave relevant empty — recall will be ~0.
